answers.builder_check: A Haiku builder needs: the helper path (cairn/devices/cc/scripts/commons_paths.py, argv[1]=id, prints newline-separated repo-relative paths from 'git status --porcelain -uall' run in cwd = the commons, journal included if dirty); the exact replacement line in both scripts: (cd $CC && P=$(python3 $C/cairn/devices/cc/scripts/commons_paths.py $ID) && [ -n "$P" ] && git add -- $P && git commit ... -- $P); and that the proof extracts the line containing 'commons_paths.py' from each script and runs it with bash, C=the house repo, CC=a scratch git commons. All are written in the ticket's decisions.

answers.collision_check: Against da29186ef039 (an unanswered clearance is not a refusal, close.sh's RC 3 branch): no collision; commit_all's subject and call sites are unchanged, only what it stages. answers.falsifier_check: Clauses: (1) given a scratch commons dirty with own and foreign files in all five dirs, commons_paths.py <id> lists every own path and no foreign one; (2) close.sh's commons staging line, run as written against that scratch commons, commits exactly the own paths plus the journal and leaves the foreign ones dirty; (3) the same for prove.sh. Measured red at HEAD 2026-11-19: 17 commons commits since 2026-10-15 under a close.sh/prove.sh subject carry a foreign ticket (aa7d25c1, 718f7c0c3, b881b1e12...).
